summary.text: Julie Gable is the Democratic candidate for the Arizona House of Representatives, District 3, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a business leader whose career includes systems projects at Accenture, technology consulting firms she owned and operated, and a recent role as CEO of a healthcare company.

paragraphs.text: Gable graduated from Los Alamos High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Arizona State University.

In the survey she said she led complex systems projects at Accenture, owned and operated local technology consulting firms, and most recently served as CEO of a healthcare company, and that the Phoenix Business Journal recognized her as an Outstanding Woman in Business.
Gable said she and her husband have lived in the district for 25 years and raised two daughters in local schools.
She said she serves on the boards of the Arizona Humane Society and the Phoenix Zoo (ACNC) and is a Clean Elections candidate who accepts no PAC money or corporate donations.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on July 21, 2026, with 56.1 percent of the vote in the two-seat race.
Gable listed healthcare access, responsible technology policy and water security as her key campaign messages.
